episode.title: Recover reasoning-only incomplete turns by failing over without leaking protocol-specific replay state
episode.before: At parent d45fd1aa31e54e411a0df2661849ccb255c22ed6, an incomplete Codex Responses turn used one bare replay and then a synthetic continuation nudge, but all incomplete responses shared one three-attempt counter. On the third incomplete response, even when every response contained only internal reasoning and no visible answer or tool call, the turn reset the counter, persisted the transcript, and returned a terminal partial result. It did not classify this condition as a failover reason, activate a configured fallback, grant a bounded call when the iteration budget was exhausted, rebind the system prompt to the fallback identity, or remove the Codex-only nudge when assembling a request for another protocol.
episode.after: At merge commit 656eb283096c979ae4e6dc454920c2038e622990, the turn maintains a separate consecutive reasoning-only streak, resetting it when visible output or a normal response breaks the streak. The third consecutive incomplete response with neither visible text nor a tool call activates the next configured fallback using the semantic reason incomplete_response. If the trigger consumed the iteration budget, exactly one grace call is armed so the fallback can answer. Response intake then refreshes the active system prompt after failover and continues the same turn. When the destination uses a different protocol, request assembly drops both thinking-only replay rows and the synthetic continuation nudge before merging adjacent user rows, preserving valid role alternation. If no fallback is available, the existing terminal partial-result path remains.
episode.diff: The change adds an incomplete_response failover category and per-turn reasoning-only streak state; extends incomplete-response continuation to distinguish visible partials from reasoning-only stalls, activate fallback after three consecutive stalls, and arm one bounded grace call; propagates a fallback-activated control result through response intake so the system prompt is synchronized before retrying; extends transcript normalization with an optional exact nudge marker and applies it only on cross-protocol requests; and adds focused tests for successful fallback with one grace call, streak behavior after visible partial output, cross-protocol cleanup and role alternation, plus enum coverage and fixture initialization.

evidence_units.claim: The pinned implementation is merge commit 656eb283096c979ae4e6dc454920c2038e622990 with first parent d45fd1aa31e54e411a0df2661849ccb255c22ed6; its subject identifies PR #115822 and describes switching reasoning-only stalls to a fallback provider instead of ending incomplete.
evidence_units.source: git show --format=fuller --stat 656eb283096c979ae4e6dc454920c2038e622990; issue-bundle.json resolved_commit, parent_commit, and commit_show_stat

evidence_units.claim: The parent implementation incremented one aggregate incomplete counter, retried only while it was below three, then reset the counter, persisted the session, and returned a partial result stating that the response remained incomplete after three continuation attempts.

The change computes reasoning_only as absence of visible content and tool calls, advances a separate consecutive streak only for that condition, and resets the streak on a non-reasoning-only incomplete response.
evidence_units.source: git diff d45fd1aa31e54e411a0df2661849ccb255c22ed6 656eb283096c979ae4e6dc454920c2038e622990 -- agent/turn_truncation.py, hunk around continue_codex_incomplete

evidence_units.claim: On a reasoning-only streak of at least three, continuation attempts fallback activation with FailoverReason.incomplete_response; successful activation resets both counters, records the session messages, emits diagnostics, and returns the CODEX_FALLBACK_ACTIVATED control value.

If failover is activated after the normal iteration allowance is consumed, the implementation sets _budget_grace_call so the next iteration can make one fallback request; the streak is reset, preventing this branch from independently granting another grace call.
evidence_units.source: git show 656eb283096c979ae4e6dc454920c2038e622990:agent/turn_truncation.py, reasoning-only fallback branch and accompanying invariant comment

evidence_units.claim: The error taxonomy gains incomplete_response as the semantic reason for an incomplete turn stuck emitting reasoning without an answer or tool call after replay and nudge.
Per-turn initialization now resets _codex_reasoning_only_streak to zero independently of the aggregate incomplete-response counter.

Response intake recognizes CODEX_FALLBACK_ACTIVATED, synchronizes the failover system message to the new model/provider identity, returns a continue verdict, and carries the rebound active_system_prompt to its caller.

Transcript normalization accepts an optional exact nudge marker, removes matching synthetic user rows in the same pass as thinking-only assistant rows, and then merges adjacent users to retain valid role alternation.
Request assembly treats any non-Codex destination as cross-protocol and supplies the Codex continuation nudge as a drop marker while also dropping Codex reasoning items.

A focused test supplies three reasoning-only incomplete responses followed by a fallback answer and asserts completion, FailoverReason.incomplete_response, four total API calls from a three-call budget, and consumption of the single grace-call flag.

A focused test places visible partial progress before three reasoning-only responses and verifies that the turn still reaches the configured fallback and completes with its answer, exercising separation of the local consecutive streak from aggregate incomplete handling.

A cross-protocol test switches the fallback to chat completions and asserts that the final wire request contains neither the synthetic Codex nudge nor encrypted reasoning items and that its non-system message roles alternate.
Enum coverage is updated to require incomplete_response among the supported failover reasons, and existing incomplete-budget test setup initializes the new streak state.

Developer documentation records the operational invariant: three consecutive reasoning-only continuations fail over, and exhaustion of the iteration budget permits exactly one bounded fallback grace call.

The merge's first-parent diff contains implementation and test changes across the turn state, continuation, response-intake, request-assembly, transcript-normalization, error-taxonomy, and focused-test modules rather than only metadata or documentation.

candidate_atomics.name: track-consecutive-nonproductive-stream-responses
candidate_atomics.description: Classify incomplete responses by observable productivity and maintain a local consecutive-stall counter that is independent of the aggregate continuation count.

semantic_action.intent: Distinguish a repeatedly nonproductive response stream from incomplete responses that contain visible progress, so recovery escalation is based on a consecutive failure signal.
semantic_action.pre_state: An incomplete response has been normalized, and the turn has an aggregate continuation count but no independent consecutive reasoning-only signal.
semantic_action.post_state: The turn's reasoning-only streak is incremented only when the response has neither visible text nor a tool call and is reset when that predicate is false or normal processing resumes.
semantic_action.validation: Exercise a sequence containing visible partial output followed by reasoning-only incompletes and verify that escalation occurs only after the required consecutive reasoning-only responses.

candidate_atomics.name: escalate-persistent-stream-stall-to-bounded-failover
candidate_atomics.description: After the bounded replay-and-nudge ladder fails to produce an answer or tool call, activate a configured fallback and ensure it receives at most one call beyond an exhausted turn budget.

semantic_action.intent: Recover a turn that repeatedly emits only internal reasoning instead of terminating it as an incomplete partial result when another execution backend is available.
semantic_action.pre_state: The same turn has produced at least three consecutive incomplete responses with no visible answer and no tool call after the existing replay and continuation-nudge attempts.
semantic_action.post_state: A configured fallback is activated with an incomplete-response reason, continuation counters are reset, and the fallback can make exactly one bounded grace request if the ordinary iteration budget was exhausted; without an available fallback, the prior terminal partial path remains.
semantic_action.validation: Feed three reasoning-only incomplete responses under a three-call iteration budget, then a fallback answer; assert the semantic failover reason, successful completion, four total calls, and a consumed grace flag.

candidate_atomics.name: reconcile-turn-identity-after-midturn-failover
candidate_atomics.description: Propagate a distinct failover-activated control result through response intake and refresh the active system prompt before continuing the same turn.

semantic_action.intent: Ensure the request following midturn failover represents the newly active model and provider rather than retaining stale identity metadata.
semantic_action.pre_state: Incomplete-response recovery has activated a fallback during response intake, while the caller still holds a system prompt assembled for the previous backend.
semantic_action.post_state: The active system prompt is synchronized to the fallback identity and returned with a continue verdict for the next iteration.
semantic_action.validation: Complete a reasoning-only stall sequence through fallback and verify that the same turn continues to and accepts the fallback response; the code-level oracle is the distinct activation sentinel and rebound active_system_prompt.

candidate_atomics.name: sanitize-protocol-specific-recovery-state-on-failover
candidate_atomics.description: Remove the source protocol's continuation marker and opaque reasoning replay state before sending the preserved conversation to a different protocol, then restore role alternation.

semantic_action.intent: Prevent internal recovery controls and opaque replay artifacts from leaking into a fallback request that cannot interpret them.
semantic_action.pre_state: A turn has failed over across protocols, and its preserved transcript may contain thinking-only assistant replay rows plus a synthetic user continuation marker.
semantic_action.post_state: The destination request excludes source-protocol reasoning state and the exact synthetic marker, adjacent user messages are merged, and non-system roles alternate.
semantic_action.validation: Capture the first cross-protocol fallback request and assert absence of both the marker and encrypted reasoning items while checking adjacent roles differ.

candidate_workflows.name: recover-a-reasoning-only-stream-stall-through-safe-failover
candidate_workflows.description: Detect consecutive nonproductive incomplete responses, escalate only after bounded continuation attempts, reconcile the active turn identity, and project a clean transcript to the fallback protocol before validating completion and budget bounds.

workflow_graph.goal: Complete a turn through an available fallback when bounded stream continuation repeatedly yields internal reasoning but no visible answer or tool call, without unbounded retries or protocol-state leakage.
workflow_graph.entry_state: A streaming/response-oriented backend has returned an incomplete response, the turn supports replay and continuation, and a fallback may be configured.
workflow_graph.exit_state: Either the configured fallback receives a normalized continuation and completes the same turn within the bounded grace policy, or no fallback is available and the established terminal partial-result behavior is used.
unresolved_or_deferred: Cross-protocol transcript sanitization is conditional: it is unnecessary when the fallback retains the same response protocol.
The evidence establishes the configured no-fallback branch by implementation inspection, but the new focused test file does not include a dedicated assertion for that branch.
This single repository workflow is insufficient to induce or promote a cross-project resolution pattern.

unresolved_questions: The checkout worktree is sparse and does not contain the tests directory; focused tests were inspected directly from the pinned Git objects, but an attempted isolated archive-based test run was interrupted before completion, so no local execution result is claimed.
